title: Electricity Supply

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency.

fields.name: sector
fields.title: Sector
fields.description: [Categorical] All sectors ('total'), local ('local') with breakdown into public (local_public') and private ('local_private') installations, imports ('imports'), or distribution ('distribution').

fields.name: supply
fields.title: Electricity Supply
fields.description: [Float] Amount of electricity supplied in millions of kilowatt-hours (MKWh).

methodology: The Malaysian electrical grid is managed by Tenaga Nasional Berhad (for Peninsular Malaysia), Sabah Electricity Sdn. Bhd., and Sarawak Energy Berhad. Independent power producers also supply electricity. This dataset includes monthly electricity supply data categorized by sector, compiled from the operational records of these providers.
caveat: Data for the most recent 6 months is provisional and subject to revision in future updates.
